key_idea: Approximate the area functional by prescribed-mean-curvature functionals A^{εh}, with h chosen generically so that the inhomogeneous Jacobi equation L φ = 2h has only sign-changing solutions on each candidate limit, which rules out higher multiplicity; then pass to the double cover of the cycle space by Caccioppoli sets to bring in the volume spectrum.
reason: The core strategy is striking and explains why multiplicity collapses: a perturbing mean curvature forces opposite-orientation sheets to separate in a way incompatible with a sign-preserving limit, and the Caccioppoli double-cover lift is a neat conceptual bridge. However, the proof has to rebuild a full multi-parameter relative min-max theory, with discretization, interpolation, pull-tight, compactness and index bounds, and that heavy technical machinery buries the elegant core.
recognized: Xin Zhou, 'On the Multiplicity One Conjecture in Min-max theory' (Annals of Math. 2020)
